QUOTE: sets up a heap over a caller-supplied buffer, with a mutex when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on; calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(buffer_alloc_calloc_mutexed, buffer_alloc_free_mutexed)` (or the non-mutexed pair)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init` installs the mutexed pair when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on and otherwise the non-mutexed pair. It doesn't say the choice is made at compile time, but the `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` condition implies it.
